## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 💡 Motivation
Why would this feature be useful? What problem does it solve?

## 📋 Detailed Description
Provide a detailed description of how you envision this feature working.

## 🎯 Use Cases
Describe specific use cases for this feature:
1. Use case 1...
2. Use case 2...
3. Use case 3...

## 💻 Proposed Implementation
If you have ideas about how this could be implemented, share them here.

### API Changes (if applicable)
```javascript
// Example of new API endpoint or changes
POST /generate/new-feature
{
  "parameter1": "value",
  "parameter2": "value"
}
```

### Configuration Changes (if applicable)
```json
{
  "newSetting": "value",
  "feature": {
    "enabled": true,
    "options": {}
  }
}
```

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📊 Priority
How important is this feature to you?
- [ ] Critical - blocks my work
- [ ] High - significantly improves my workflow
- [ ] Medium - nice to have
- [ ] Low - minor improvement

## 🎨 UI/UX Considerations
If this feature affects the user interface or experience, describe:
- How should it be presented to users?
- What should the user flow look like?
- Any accessibility considerations?

## 🧪 Testing Considerations
How should this feature be tested?
- Unit tests needed?
- Integration tests needed?
- Manual testing scenarios?

## 📚 Documentation Impact
What documentation would need to be updated?
- [ ] README.md
- [ ] API documentation
- [ ] Examples
- [ ] Installation guide

## ✅ Checklist
- [ ] I have searched existing issues and feature requests
- [ ] I have provided a clear description
- [ ] I have explained the motivation and use cases
- [ ] I understand this may take time to implement

## 🤝 Contribution
Would you be interested in contributing to implement this feature?
- [ ] Yes, I'd like to work on this
- [ ] Yes, I can help with testing
- [ ] Yes, I can help with documentation
- [ ] No, but I'd be happy to provide feedback
